Date Type

CDate is the 4-byte date type stored in gxRDBMS DATE fields.

Contents

Overview
Functions

Overview

The layout (month byte, day byte, 16-bit year) is part of the gxRDBMS file format and is unchanged. Comparisons order dates by year, month and day. Use std::chrono for date arithmetic.

Functions

bool CDate::SetDate(std::string_view date, char delimiter = '/')

Parses M/D/YYYY. Returns false, leaving 0/0/0, for text that is not a valid date.
